column1: # OpenPedCan cancer_group -> OncoTree code. Curated by hand; only codes the
# curator is confident of are filled. Blank = intentionally unmapped (broad
# groups such as "Low-grade glioma" span several OncoTree codes). Codes are from
# the curator's knowledge of OncoTree, not checked live (oncotree.info was
# unreachable): verify before relying on them. Unmapped
# groups are reported by build-ccdi, never dropped.
Clear cell sarcoma of the kidney
